commit.message:
fix(site): derive skill doc links from command slug

The rename to hyphenated skill directories left Skills.astro building
links as skills/egm_${skill.icon}/SKILL.md, so all seven website cards
linked to removed paths. Derive the directory from the existing command
('/egm-brainstorm' -> 'egm-brainstorm'), which also handles
egm-review-loop and egm-drift-report correctly. Verified by building the
site: dist/index.html now contains only egm-* SKILL.md links.

fix: hyphenate skill directories and drop $schema for omp compatibility

omp (Oh My Pi, #186) fails to discover any EGM skills for two reasons,
both verified against omp v18.12.6:

1. Skill directories use underscores (skills/egm_brainstorm) while the
   SKILL.md frontmatter declares hyphenated names (name: egm-brainstorm).
   omp's skill validator only accepts directory names matching
   [a-z0-9-]+, so all seven skills are silently dropped at discovery.
   Claude Code tolerates the mismatch; omp does not. Rename the
   directories to match the declared names.

2. The $schema key in root plugin.json routes omp to its strict
   agent-plugins validator, which rejects the skills'
   disable-model-invocation frontmatter field (bisected with probe
   plugins: license and folded descriptions pass;
   disable-model-invocation fails). Omit the key so omp falls back to
   its permissive Claude-plugin scanner; manifest content is unchanged.
   disable-model-invocation is retained because it is core to EGM's
   user-invocation design.

Also updates the path references (README, designs docs, pack script,
tests, Claude adapter), regenerates distributions/claude, documents omp
in docs/harnesses.md, and records the community verification in
TESTING.md.

commit.message:
docs(drift-report): describe the skill and its test files accurately

The README and architecture overview called /egm-drift-report an AST scanner,
but the skill is a prompt-driven agent workflow with no parser. The design's
Implementation Files table listed TEST.md as unit tests and
test_scenarios.yaml as a benchmark; TEST.md only points to the repository's
frontmatter and link checks, and no in-repo runner executes the single
scenario's assertion.
fix(tests): make offline checks portable to Windows

fix(codebase-details): check document claims against the code

Flag statements that the code contradicts and references that do not
exist. Do not flag files that the plan will create.

feat(resolve): add ESCALATE and DECLINE

Some findings are wrong, but only facts outside the document show this.
Give these findings to the user. Do not add context only for the reviewer.
Record Nits without a fix. A contest must cite evidence.

test(egm_draft): catch more picking phrases in owner scenario

Add "I'll pick/choose/go with", "I've made the call", "Decision: ", and "Go with <Option>" to the forbidden pattern. Old-skill runs used these phrases to pick for the owner.

feat: add architecture choice delegation scenario to testing suite

description: Add Execution Constraint 13, "Owner Decides Architecture". When a design
decision has more than one defensible answer, egm_draft presents up to
three options with their mechanism, trade-offs, and failure conditions,
and asks the owner to choose through the single-select gate. It does not
rank options, mark a default, or pick one. If the owner asks it to
choose, it restates the trade-offs and presents the same gate again.
Mechanical choices with one defensible answer stay with the agent.

Add the owner_delegates_architecture_choice scenario: the owner asks the
agent to pick twice, and each reply must ask the owner to choose and must
not contain picking phrases.

commit.message:
feat(claude): approve plugin file reads with a PreToolUse hook

Personas and standards are in the plugin cache, outside the project.
Without a permission rule, Claude Code asks for each read in an
interactive session and refuses it in a headless run or a background
subagent. The hook approves Read, Grep and Glob only in the plugin's
agents/, docs/, resources/ and skills/ folders. All other calls get the
normal permission rules, and deny and ask rules still apply.

commit.message:
site: render og.png at 2x and enlarge its type (#111)

* site: render og.png at 2x (2400x1260)

The social image was captured at 1200x630 device pixels, so link previews
on high-DPI displays showed soft edges on the mark and text. capture.mjs
now takes a scale option and renders og.png with deviceScaleFactor 2; the
layout is unchanged at 1200x630 CSS pixels. og:image:width/height now
report the real pixel size.

* site: enlarge og.png type for feed-size previews

Link previews render the 1200x630 canvas at roughly half width, so the
20-34px type read as 10-15px. Brand 24->40, domain 20->32, card names
34->60, captions 20->32; mark 232->200 so the card bottoms still fit.

* site: og.png header at one size, captions without periods

egm.dev now matches the brand at 40px so the header reads as one line;
colour still separates it. Card captions drop their trailing periods.

* site: og.png uses two type sizes

Brand and card names share 48px; egm.dev and captions share 32px.

* site: rebalance og.png and simplify its template

Consistent spacing scale (56px canvas padding, 36px header gap, 32px card
gap, 40/48/44px card padding), mark at 176px centred to the pixel in each
card, goldfish crop recentred on its ink. Name and caption are centred
under the mark and the caption uses the same ink as the heading. egm.dev
removed from the header. Stylesheet rewritten around six tokens; the
card-bottom wrapper, desc-gf modifier and inline SVG size attributes are
gone.

commit.message:
site: rebalance the logo mark (Matched Fork) (#108)

Trunk and tail now share one material (open 2.4 round strokes), reach
the same 10.1 units from the seam on both sides, and the trunk exits the
body on the axis with its belly raised 0.45. The tail becomes a forked
pair of strokes (2.9-unit fork) so the goldfish still reads at 16 px.
Split-mark viewBox is 1.5 1.5 21 21, centred on (12,12) with equal margins.

Applied to public/favicon.svg, components/Mark.astro and scripts/og.html;
og.png and screenshots regenerated with npm run capture.
